_comment: card_slug (Webflow CMS 'Featured Listings Cards' item fieldData.slug) -> registry_slug (config/listings.json listing.slug). Kept even for cards currently archived/unpublished on Webflow (see get_featured_slugs() docstring) so a re-publish is picked up automatically without editing this file again.
